DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生用のイーゼルをお借りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to borrow an easel for sketching?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベンチに座って描きたいので、画板を低い位置へ置ける物を借りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座位で描くため低く調節できる貸出イーゼルを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to sit on a bench to draw, so I would like one that holds the drawing board low down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a loan easel that adjusts low enough for drawing while seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは台の高さを変えられます。画板の大きさはどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The support height on this one is adjustable. How large is your drawing board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この四十センチの板です。下の台だけでなく、上も押さえられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四十センチ画板と上下固定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this forty-centimetre board. Can it be secured at the top as well as on the lower support?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about securing a forty-centimetre drawing board at both top and bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上の留め具も動かせます。職員が板に合わせて調節します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The upper clamp moves too. A staff member will adjust it to fit your board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。板を載せてから、自分が座ったときの高さを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板設置後の座位高さ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. After the board is in place, I would like to check its height while sitting down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the seated height after the board is installed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 板を固定しました。こちらに座って、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The board is secured. Please sit here and take a look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この高さなら手が届きます。少し傾きを変えることもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手が届くことを確認し傾き調節を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can reach it at this height. Can I also change the angle a little?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can reach it and ask about adjusting the angle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのつまみで調節できます。固定した状態を確認してから描き始めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can adjust it with that knob. Check that it is secured before you start drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 職員の方と傾きも確認できました。この位置で描き、終わったら板を外してイーゼルを受付へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職員と固定確認後に写生し板を外して返すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the angle with a staff member too. I will draw in this position, then remove the board and return the easel to reception when I finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will sketch after checking the fastening with staff, then remove the board and return the easel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ写生をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your sketching. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 有料の待合室をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions to the paid waiting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の列車まで四十五分あります。座って少し休みたいですが、短い時間でも使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発車まで四十五分の短時間有料待合室利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are forty-five minutes until my next train. I would like to sit and rest a little. Can I use it for a short time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using the paid waiting room briefly during the forty-five minutes before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一時間の利用料金でお入りいただけます。座席と机があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can enter for the one-hour fee. There are seats and tables.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十分だけでも一時間分なのですね。その料金で構いません。今、空いた席はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時間料金を了承し空席を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even twenty minutes costs one hour. That fee is fine. Are there any seats free now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the one-hour fee and ask about available seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓側に空きがあります。列車の案内表示も見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a window seat available. You can also see the train information display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓側を希望します。飲み物を買って持ち込めるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓側席を選び飲物持込みを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like the window seat. I also want to ask whether I can buy a drink and bring it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a window seat and check whether drinks may be brought in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物は机でお飲みいただけます。入口で利用券をご購入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may drink at the table. Please buy a ticket at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 利用券を買いました。発車の十分前には室内を出るよう、自分の時計で時間を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用券購入と発車十分前退出の管理を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have bought the ticket. I will watch the time on my own watch so I leave the room ten minutes before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you bought the ticket and will manage your time to leave ten minutes before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 退出時には、券を入口の箱へお入れください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When leaving, please put the ticket in the box at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休めましたので、予定の時刻に出ます。飲み物と荷物を持ち、券を箱へ戻してホームへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩終了後荷物飲物回収と券返却及び乗車を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have had a rest, so I will leave at the planned time. I will take my drink and belongings, return the ticket to the box and head to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are ending your break, collecting your drink and belongings, returning the ticket and going to board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for using the room. Take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your enquiry about a road?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅近くの交差点で、塀の向こうの自転車が見えません。道路の鏡を付けてもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 塀で自転車が見えない交差点の鏡設置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: At an intersection near my home, I cannot see bicycles beyond a wall. I would like to ask whether a road mirror could be installed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about installing a mirror at an intersection where a wall blocks the view of bicycles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と、見えにくい方向を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the location and which direction is hard to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地図の角です。東から歩いて来ると、北側の細い道が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 接近方向と見えない北側道を図示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this corner on the map. Walking from the east, I cannot see the narrow road to the north.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your approach direction and the obscured northern road on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道路の担当が現地の条件を確認します。写真はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The road department will check the site conditions. Do you have any photographs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩道から撮った写真があります。車道へ出ない位置で、塀と角が写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩道から撮った写真の範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photograph taken from the pavement. It shows the wall and corner from a position where I did not step into the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain what is shown in the photograph taken from the pavement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 設置の可否は確認後の回答です。これまでに何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can answer whether installation is possible after checking. Has anything happened there before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日、自転車とぶつかりそうになりました。けがはなく、相手と話す前に離れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日の接触未遂と無傷及び相手情報なしを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yesterday I nearly collided with a bicycle. I was not injured, and we parted before I could speak to the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe yesterday's near collision, no injury and lack of information about the other person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過も添えて相談を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will accept your enquiry with that account as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地図と写真を出します。鏡が付くと決まったわけではないので、返事までは角で立ち止まって周囲を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を提出し設置未確定中の本人行動を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit the map and photograph. A mirror has not been approved, so until I hear back I will stop at the corner and look around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the material and explain what you will do while installation remains undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 道路の担当へお伝えします。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the road department. Thank you for your enquiry. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査前の確認をします。身に着けている物で、ご相談はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are checking before your examination. Is there anything you are wearing that you want to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歯の矯正で、取り外せる器具を使っています。金属の部分があるので、検査前に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 可撤歯科器具の金属部分を検査前に申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a removable orthodontic appliance. It has metal parts, so I would like you to check it before the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare the metal parts of a removable dental appliance before the examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの器具か、担当へ伝えます。説明の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the person in charge which appliance it is. Do you have any information about it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歯科でもらった紙があります。材質は自分では分からないので、これを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 材質不明と歯科説明紙を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a paper from the dentist. I do not know the material myself, so please look at this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the material and show the dentist's information sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査への影響と取外しの必要は、検査担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The examination staff will check its effect on the examination and whether it needs to be removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外すことはできます。しまうケースも持っているので、必要ならケースへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取外し可能とケース持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can remove it. I also brought its storage case, so I will put it in the case if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is removable and that you brought a case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の確認が終わるまで、そのままでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave it as it is until the staff finish checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は触らず待ちます。外すと話しやすさも変わるので、説明は外す前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取外しで発話が変わるため説明先行を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait without touching it now. Removing it also changes how easily I can speak, so I would like to hear the explanation before removing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to hear the explanation first because removing the appliance affects your speech. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順番も含めて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff about that order as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料とケースを準備しました。確認の返事を聞いてから外すか決めますので、担当へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料ケース準備と担当回答後の取外しを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the information sheet and case ready. I will decide whether to remove it after hearing their answer, so please tell the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the sheet and case are ready and removal will depend on the staff's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。検査担当へおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will put you in touch with the examination staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車の通行についてでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車庫の前に知らない車が止まっていて、自分の車を出せません。どう相談すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない車で車庫から出せない状況を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unfamiliar car is parked in front of my garage, and I cannot get my car out. How should I ask for help?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because an unfamiliar car prevents you from leaving your garage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今もその場所に止まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it still parked there now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分前に家を出るときに見て、ここへ来ました。家族は今も同じ場所にあると言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認時点と家族の現時点情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw it when I left home ten minutes ago and came here. My family says it is still in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State when you saw it yourself and the current information from your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車の番号と、道路上の位置は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know its registration number and position on the road?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この写真で番号が読めます。車庫の扉に沿って止まり、歩道の一部もふさいでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真番号と扉沿い歩道上の位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: You can read the number in this photograph. It is parked along the garage door and also blocks part of the pavement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the number in the photograph and its position along the door and on the pavement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運転していた方は見ましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見ていません。クラクションで呼ぶより、状況をお伝えして相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運転者未目撃と警察相談の希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Rather than sounding the horn to summon them, I want to explain the situation and ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you did not see the driver and want to consult the police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出入りが必要な時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We would also like to know when you need to enter or leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十一時に荷物を積んで出る予定です。車を動かす対応について、担当から案内を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十一時の出庫予定と対応案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I plan to load my belongings and leave at eleven. I would like the person in charge to advise me on having the car moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the eleven o'clock departure plan and ask for guidance on handling it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真と現状を確認します。続きは担当が伺いますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the photograph and current situation. The person in charge will hear the rest. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外向けの封筒ですね。中には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This envelope is going overseas. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手紙と押し花です。紙の間に挟んでありますが、植物が入るので、送れるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙内押し花の国際送付可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A letter and pressed flowers. The flowers are between sheets of paper, but since they are plants, I want to ask first whether I can send them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether pressed flowers enclosed with a letter can be sent internationally. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送り先の国と、植物の種類が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the destination country and type of plant?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この国へ送ります。庭の花ですが、名前は分かりません。写真は残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先国と不明植物名及び写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am sending it to this country. They are flowers from my garden, but I do not know their name. I still have photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination country and photographs, and say the plant's name is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類や状態によって確認が必要です。担当へ写真をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check depending on the type and condition. Please show the photographs to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 種や土は入れていません。花だけでも確認が必要なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 種土なしと花自体の条件確認を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are no seeds or soil. So even just flowers need checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State there are no seeds or soil and acknowledge that the flowers themselves need checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件が分かるまでは受付を進めず、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will not proceed with acceptance until the conditions are known. The person in charge will advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送れない場合は、花の写真を印刷したものに替えます。手紙はそのまま送れる形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可時の写真代替と手紙発送希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they cannot be sent, I will replace them with printed photographs of the flowers. I want to keep the letter in a form that can be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest printed photographs if sending is prohibited, and say you still want to send the letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容を替える場合は、差し出す前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you change the contents, please tell us before posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は押し花を取り出して持ち帰り、写真に替えてから来ることにします。花の入らない封筒として改めてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 押し花持帰りと写真に替えた再来局を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will take out the pressed flowers and take them home, then come back after replacing them with photographs. I will ask again to send an envelope containing no flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the pressed flowers home and return after replacing them with photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご準備後にお越しください。お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please come back when it is ready. We look forward to seeing you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みのご依頼ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to make a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ業者から請求書が二枚来ました。振込み先は同じですが、一度に合計で振り込んでよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同先二請求書の合算振込み可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received two invoices from the same supplier. The bank details are the same, but I am unsure whether I can pay the total in one transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two invoices to the same recipient can be combined into one transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取側が指定する番号や記載事項はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the recipient specified any numbers or information to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それぞれ別の請求番号があります。業者にはまだ合算してよいか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別請求番号と業者未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each has a different invoice number. I have not yet asked the supplier whether I may combine them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the different invoice numbers and that you have not checked with the supplier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に受取側へ確認していただくと、依頼内容を決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Checking with the recipient first will let you decide what to request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今電話します。合算する場合に二つの番号をどう伝えるかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 業者へ合算及び番号通知方法を問い合わせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call now. I will also ask how to convey both numbers if I combine the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the supplier about combining payment and how to notify both numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込み依頼書は、回答を受けてからご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please fill out the transfer form after you receive their answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 業者から、金額は合計し、番号は別途メールで知らせてよいと返事がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合算と別途メール番号通知の回答を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The supplier replied that I may combine the amounts and send the numbers separately by email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report permission to combine the amounts and notify the numbers separately by email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、合計額と振込み先をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will check the total and recipient here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二万円と一万五千円で三万五千円です。この一件でお願いします。振込み後に二つの番号と控えを業者へ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三万五千円の一件振込み及び事後通知を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Twenty thousand plus fifteen thousand is thirty-five thousand yen. Please make it one transfer. Afterwards I will send both invoice numbers and the receipt to the supplier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request one thirty-five-thousand-yen transfer and say you will notify the supplier afterwards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合計額を確認しました。お手続きの窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed the total. Please go to the transaction counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 詰め替え用をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a refill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の洗剤のボトルへ入れたいです。商品名は同じですが、この袋は「濃縮」と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名濃縮詰替えと自宅本体適合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to put it in my detergent bottle at home. The product name is the same, but this pouch says “concentrated”.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a concentrated refill with the same name fits your bottle at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本体の種類が分かる写真はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a photograph showing the type of bottle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真を撮ってきました。元のボトルには濃縮の文字がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 非濃縮本体の写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took a photograph. The original bottle does not say “concentrated”.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show a photograph of the non-concentrated bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋に対応する本体の表示があります。写真の本体とは別の種類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pouch shows the compatible bottle. It is a different type from the one in your photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ名前だけでは選べないのですね。元の本体に対応する袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別種を理解し対応袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the same name alone is not enough to choose. Do you have a pouch compatible with my original bottle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different type and ask for the compatible pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの袋が写真の本体用です。詰め替えの注意は裏の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This pouch is for the bottle in your photograph. Read the precautions on the back before refilling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この袋を買います。家のボトルに残っている量もあるので、入れる前に裏の注意を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対応袋購入と注意表示確認を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy this pouch. There is also some detergent left in my bottle, so I will read the precautions on the back before adding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the compatible pouch and say you will check the precautions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: サイズは二種類あります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋にします。対応する本体が分かったので、まとめ買いせず今回必要な一袋を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小サイズ一袋の購入を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the small pouch. Now that I know the compatible bottle, I will choose just the one pouch I need this time instead of buying in bulk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will buy one small pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの小さい袋ですね。お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This small pouch, then. Please go to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広場のご利用についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your enquiry about using the square?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい凧を持ってきました。ここで揚げられる時間と場所があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小型凧の利用場所と時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a small kite. Please tell me if there is a time and place where I can fly it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where and when you can fly a small kite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の広場は、午後に団体の利用があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A group is using the square this afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は午前ですが、準備の前まで使えますか。長い糸は使わず、子どもと短く揚げたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 団体準備前の短時間親子利用と短糸を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is morning now. Can we use it until they start setting up? I would like to fly it briefly with my child, without using a long string.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for brief parent-and-child use with a short string before group preparations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる範囲を担当へ確認します。電線のある側では揚げないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the usable area with the person in charge. Please do not fly it on the side with power lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電線のない中央側の範囲が希望です。遊んでいる人が多ければ今日はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電線なし範囲と混雑時中止を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would prefer the central area without power lines. If there are many people playing, we will give up for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an area without power lines and say you will stop if it is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から、中央の範囲で十一時までとの案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge says you may use the central area until eleven.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は十時半です。十五分ほどにして、十一時より前に道具をしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十一時期限内の十五分利用を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is ten thirty now. We will keep it to about fifteen minutes and pack up before eleven.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose fifteen minutes of use within the eleven o'clock limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 風と周囲の人の動きも見ながらご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also watch the wind and the movements of people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 風が強くなるなら早めに終えます。糸を全部巻き取ってから広場を出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 風による早期終了と糸収納後退出を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the wind gets stronger, we will finish early. We will leave the square after winding up all the string.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to end early depending on the wind and leave after winding up the string. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、時間と範囲を守ってお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy yourselves while keeping to the time and area. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: チェロのケースを持っています。座席の横に置くと通路へ出そうなので、乗る前に置き場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チェロケースの通路にはみ出さない置場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a cello case. Beside my seat it looks as though it would stick out into the aisle, so I want to ask where to put it before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to put a cello case without obstructing the aisle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きさを確認します。予約した座席はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the size. Do you have a reserved seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 指定席です。高さは百二十センチほどで、こちらが座席番号です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定席番号と高さを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, a reserved seat. It is about one hundred and twenty centimetres tall, and this is my seat number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your reserved seat number and the height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持込みの条件と車内で置ける場所を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the conditions for bringing it aboard and where it can go on the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚に上げるには重いので、床に置ける候補を希望します。演奏はせず、ケースは閉じたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重量から床置き希望と閉ケースを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is too heavy to lift onto a rack, so I would like possible places on the floor. I will not play it, and the case will stay closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that its weight means you prefer floor storage and that the case will stay closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車の担当へお尋ねします。座席の変更も相談してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the train staff. May I also ask about changing your seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物に合う場所の近くへ変えられるならお願いします。通路に置いたまま乗る方法は選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物置場近くへの座席変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do, if it can be changed to near a suitable luggage space. I will not choose to travel with it left in the aisle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to change to a seat near suitable luggage storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの予約内容を担当にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show these reservation details to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持込みと置き場所が分かってから、必要なら座席を変えます。まずケースの寸法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後の座席変更と寸法確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I know the carry-on conditions and storage location, I will change seats if necessary. Please check the case dimensions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the dimensions to be checked and a seat change after the conditions are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご予約とケースを担当へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you, your reservation and the case to the person in charge. Goodbye.
